reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 40 original verb questions: every complete German sentence, all 160 offered options, unique answers, verb inflection, distinct situations and bilingual hints/explanations. Reviewed source labels, CEFR and relevant existing objectives in production, initial, B2, workplace and general-expansion catalogs. Corrected verlegen's erroneous English adjective gloss, versalzen's part-of-speech gloss, sich verlaufen auxiliary ambiguity, vermitteln polysemy, verpflegen translation, and other recorded distinctions. Structural CI is required; human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approvals remain pending. Initial CI found incorrect catalog/source hashes from a custom SHA-256 implementation; corrected using standard test vectors before revalidation.
